summary: Large image tile navigation section for linking to content or categories.
features: Large image tiles with multiple format options (square, portrait, landscape)
Title positioning on or below images
Grid or slider display with navigation controls
shortDescription: The Inpage Navigation Big section creates striking visual entry points to categories or content pages using large image tiles. Each tile supports multiple image formats (square, portrait, landscape) with optional dark overlay for better text readability. Titles can be positioned directly on the image or below it with configurable alignment. The section displays as either a static grid or scrollable slider with navigation controls. Ideal for homepage category showcases, collection highlights, or feature page links where visual impact is paramount.
